YodeckTokenCredential.title: Yodeck API Token
YodeckTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing Yodeck API token value, a nonsecret label and an existing accessible workspace ID. Requests use Authorization: Token label:value. This integration does not issue tokens or log in. The selected workspace is an access witness, not account or actor identity. Permissions and entitlement remain specific to the token's role.
